groups.title: Instruments
groups.lede: Live tools with every number exposed: pull a slider, hit R for random, slow it down, export the result.

groups.title: The hero, through time
groups.lede: The home page as it stood at each turn, rebuilt from the repository - from the first lavender Three.js hero to the one-screen version that ships today.

groups.title: Project thumbnails
groups.lede: Every way the work has been shown in a frame: shader quads, particle fields, the closing grid, the evidence reel.

groups.title: Benches and decisions
groups.lede: Side-by-side options built so a choice could be made by looking, not by arguing. Each notes what was picked.

items.title: Creative Wall
items.note: A wall of real ad variants; the middle column is a reel and whichever creative lands in the centre lights up, outlined, its label decoding.

items.title: Line Field
items.note: The master D read as tone and redrawn as hairlines - flat or lifted into an isometric relief, hover to swell, click to ripple.

items.title: Grid Pens
items.note: Pens trace the swash and the D inside the closing grid's tiles, hold, and leave by blur, reverse or wipe. Exports an animated SVG.

items.title: Dot Matrix
items.note: Any image as halftone, ascii or dots - flat, on a cylinder or a globe - arriving by a sweep, crossed by a scan.

items.title: Stagger
items.note: The hero's entrance as a bench: split, offset, blur, a draggable easing curve, a live timeline. Copies the exact CSS it previews.

items.title: Glitch
items.note: The hero's hint taken apart - fringe tear, code rain, pixel hand. The CSS export keeps the hero's own two-half tear.

items.title: Flower
items.note: "Hi, I'm Ravindra." The first take on designs that convert, before the repository existed.

items.title: Lavender, in Three.js
items.note: The lavender hero that started the cluster: a live WebGL field behind the headline.

items.title: Served from the root
items.note: The lavender cluster becomes the home page, ViewRyt's design system rolled out across it.

items.title: Monochrome
items.note: The review pass: lavender gone, Onest and Redaction 35 in, colour kept only where it is an event - the aurora behind the word.

items.title: The word advertises itself
items.note: convert. tears in RGB, code rains behind it and a pixel hand presses it - until the first click.

items.title: The service drum
items.note: An iOS-picker drum of services collapses into the headline, and the case links become ink pills.

items.title: One screen
items.note: The hero cut to exactly one viewport, the word pointed at the work, the mark hung on the About wall.

items.title: Live today
items.note: What ships now: the closing grid with its colour sweep, the rubber-band sign-off, TAE Ad Studio as a film.

items.title: Raymarched quads
items.note: The first case illustrations: flat shader quads, raymarched, one per project.

items.title: Particle fields
items.note: The quads rebuilt as live particle fields that answer the pointer - what the home page still uses.

items.title: Particle bench
items.note: The THREE.Points bench and control panel the case fields were tuned in.

items.title: Closing grid
items.note: The footer replaced by a sparse scatter of work tiles, grey at rest; hover one and every copy colours.

items.title: Evidence reel lab
items.note: The animation lab for the case pages' evidence reel.

items.title: Reel axis
items.note: Horizontal feed, synthetic vertical track, three scroll spans. Picked A, shipped into IRBS.

items.title: Herbius launch system
items.note: Five stations in a line - research, ads, pages, translations, launch - with the AI skills under every one.

items.title: Loader drum
items.note: The picker-wheel veil, landing pixel-exact on the hero from 1440 down to 400.

items.title: D-GLITCH
items.note: The convert word's tear and pointer, in every variant tried.

items.title: D-CODE
items.note: Three glyph sets for the rain - lowercase, mixed, uppercase - and the no-neighbour rule.

items.title: Northern lights
items.note: The layered-fbm curtain shader behind the hero word. Parked, not deleted.

items.title: Case-link buttons
items.note: Six options, each beside its hover twin. Picked C, the solid ink pill.

items.title: Scroll progress bar
items.note: Five bars, A to E. Picked B, the comet - a full-width gradient so the fade scales with progress.

items.title: Footer sign-off
items.note: How big should the lockup be at the bottom of the page.

items.title: Mark construction
items.note: The earlier D and swash, rebuilt on a unit grid from primitives - since superseded by the master lockup.

items.title: D-TOK

items.note: Every place Redaction 35 renders, with a note field per instance.
